+5. Shared expert added to the routed result.

+- [ ] Expert SwiGLU clamps at ±10.
+- [ ] Routed reduction happens in float32.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/SwitchLayers.swift` unmodified by this task.
